assumptions: Larger sampled witness coverage and removed-edge load are useful improvement proxies.
Local triangle and C4 risk are adverse proxies.
The supplied legal proposal k is positive and the aligned vectors are bounded.
response.change_summary: Replaces raw k-dependent sums and the direct k bonus with per-switch normalization and finite/nonnegative guards.
response.design_summary: Ranks sampled witness coverage and removed-edge load with current-count weighting, while normalizing candidate evidence and local risk by proposal k.
expected_failure_modes: Sampled witnesses may miss true forbidden cycles.
Per-k normalization can under-rank a larger switch whose aggregate benefit is genuinely superlinear.
Local-risk estimates may be partial or zero when their budget is exhausted.
response.hypothesis: Per-switch sampled witness removal and load are more comparable across 2-, 3-, and 4-switch proposals; normalized local risk preserves pressure against creating short cycles.
